verdict.rationale: Orama documents programmatic access: official Orama Cloud SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust, an open-source JS library that is API-driven by design, and an auto-configured MCP server per Cloud project. Nothing in the pack shows that every dashboard/UI action (project and data-source management, collection settings, embedding-model choice) is exposed via API, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented management APIs for projects, data sources and collections, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
The APIs are designed to be as close as possible to the **Orama Cloud** APIs, so you can easily migrate your projects from **Orama Cloud** to **Orama Open Source** and vice-versa.
Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.
